name: glintbase
description: Autonomous Agent-Readiness Audit Suite, Machine Entrypoint Discovery, ARS 3.0 Playbooks, and Interactive Visual Flight Simulator.

authentication.description: Public anonymous access with rate limits (60 req/min). Optional Bearer token or API key for higher limits.

tools.name: glintbase_audit
tools.description: Execute full ARS 3.0 agent-readiness audit on a target URL.

tools.name: glintbase_get_score
tools.description: Fetch ultra-compact ARS 3.0 score card (<200 tokens).

tools.name: glintbase_simulate_flight
tools.description: Run the Glintbase Agent Flight Simulator across synthetic coding personas.

tools.name: glintbase_discover_surfaces
tools.description: Discover machine-readable entrypoints (robots.txt, llms.txt, ard.json, auth.md, OpenAPI).

tools.name: glintbase_get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve full markdown skill playbook for agent readiness.
